rationale: The assistant never asked for the model label (SV11/V7), whether the stop is a clean cut or pulsing, or what the lights do at cut-out. It contradicted itself on whether to buy, then ended with a flat 'Yes, it is the battery' with no swap test and no Dyson support diagnosis. A worn battery is the likeliest cause, but charger and body faults were not excluded. It also dismissed escalation and recommended a battery without establishing the model.
